edges.history_summary: Diane and Henry have run the practical side of the block chat together for years. Diane organises, Henry keeps records.
Diane and Constance have known each other 27 years. They walk together most mornings around the cul-de-sac.
Diane and Reggie have lived near each other for decades and check in informally about the street. Reggie tends to defer to Diane's organising.
Henry and Walter worked at the same firm in the 90s and ended up two doors apart by accident. They share the community-fund spreadsheet.
Bex and Sasha became close after Bex helped Sasha's elderly cat to the emergency vet at 2am. They walk dogs together and back each other's positions in chat.
Mei and Nadia share a love of plants and now co-tend a small set of street planters near Nadia's porch.
shared_events: joint Christmas porch decoration year one

edges.history_summary: Greg and Reggie grew up in the area; they enjoy a brief blunt back-and-forth in chat. Both prefer the street as it has been.
Greg has consistently opposed the planter project Mei runs; she once asked him directly to stop blocking it and he begrudgingly conceded only on a single round.
Tomás and Henry bonded over the August barbecue when Henry showed Tomás the bench he was making. Tomás has since helped Henry with computer issues.
shared_events: computer help on Henry's tax software

edges.history_summary: Lateefah and Priya coordinate the after-school run together; their kids are in the same year and they often chat at pickup.
Lateefah and Mei have a friendly rapport from school events; Mei is one of Lateefah's son's teachers' colleagues.
Owen and Walter respect each other's professionalism; they tend to align on contractual and financial threads in the chat.
shared_events: co-drafted the chat ground rules document

group_norms.norm_text: Members let the chat know in advance if anyone unfamiliar will be parking on the street overnight.
Everyone helps out at the annual block barbecue in some way, even if just by showing up.
Community-fund decisions are tracked in writing in the shared spreadsheet.
We keep evening events on the street to a reasonable noise level out of respect for older neighbours.
Birthday and bereavement notes go in the chat so everyone can acknowledge them.
Snow shovelling is coordinated as a rota across the cul-de-sac in winter.
